# Qualitative Error Analysis & Worked Examples

This document details representative retrieval cases across distinct error categories on the Primary Benchmark (T-Q: 200 human-verified questions).

**Provenance:** generated by `generate_worked_examples()` in `src/dl/error_analysis.py` directly from `tests/evaluation/ground_truth_qa_kh.json` and the cached per-query rankings in `results/error_analysis/*_rankings.json`. Every article number and title is looked up from the corpus at generation time, not hand-typed.

### Example 1 -- Vocabulary Mismatch (`tq-civ-009`)
- **Question**: `តើនរណាខ្លះអាចស្នើសុំឱ្យតុលាការប្រកាសបើកអាណាព្យាបាលទូទៅ?`
- **Expected**: Civil Code 2007 Art. 24 (ការប្រកាសការចាប់ផ្តើមអាណាព្យាបាលទូទៅ)
- **BM25 (lexical)**: **Miss** -- not in its top 10 at all.
- **A3 (dense)**: **Rank 1 (hit)**.
- **Why**: the question does not reuse the statute's exact wording, so lexical term-matching cannot lock onto it; the dense encoder still places the question near the article's meaning.

### Example 2 -- Exact Term Match Favours BM25 Too (`tq-civ-001`)
- **Question**: `តើគោលការណ៍ស្វ័យភាពនៃបុគ្គលឯកជនមានន័យដូចម្តេច?`
- **Expected**: Civil Code 2007 Art. 3 (គោលការណ៍ស្វ័យភាពនៃបុគ្គលឯកជន)
- **BM25**: **Rank 1**.
- **A3**: **Rank 1** as well.
- **Why it matters**: when a question already uses the statute's own wording, lexical search is not a weak baseline -- the gap between BM25 and a fine-tuned model shows up on paraphrased, conversational questions, not on quoted ones.

### Example 3 -- Multi-Article Question (`tq-civ-019`)
- **Question**: `តើប្រភេទនៃសិទ្ធិប្រត្យក្សមានអ្វីខ្លះនៅក្នុងក្រមរដ្ឋប្បវេណី?`
- **Expected**: Civil Code 2007 Art. 130 (និយមន័យនៃសិទ្ធិប្រត្យក្ស), Civil Code 2007 Art. 131 (គោលការណ៍កំណត់សិទ្ធិប្រត្យក្សដោយច្បាប់)
- **BM25 top 5**: catches 1 of the 2 expected articles.
- **A3 top 5**: catches 2 of 2, at rank(s) 2, 3.
- **Why**: the question genuinely asks about more than one article; a single top-1 metric understates cases like this, which is why Recall@5 rather than Recall@1 is the primary metric.

### Example 4 -- Civil/Criminal Code Confusion (`tq-civ-002`)
- **Question**: `តើច្បាប់ហាមឃាត់ការប្រើប្រាស់សិទ្ធិដោយបំពានយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?`
- **Expected**: Civil Code 2007 Art. 4 (ការហាមឃាត់មិនឱ្យប្រើប្រាស់សិទ្ធិដោយបំពាន)
- **A1 (BiLSTM, from scratch)**: top-1 guess is Criminal Code 2009 Art. 579 (បទបំពានលើទោសហាមឃាត់ផ្នែកវិជ្ជាជីវៈ) -- **wrong statute entirely**.
- **A3**: top-1 is Civil Code 2007 Art. 4 (ការហាមឃាត់មិនឱ្យប្រើប្រាស់សិទ្ធិដោយបំពាន) -- **correct**.
- **Why**: a from-scratch encoder trained on ~1,176 pairs has not learned a reliable boundary between the two codes' vocabularies; the pre-trained backbone has (see `results/error_analysis/error_breakdown.csv` for the full 200-question count of this error mode per model).
